args.body: Take SUPPLIER-SHOPIFY-RELEASE-REJECTION. Check the already queued deployment result first. Repeated opaque refusals justify a bounded technical handoff, not another unchanged retry. Preserve exact-digest review; do not assume provider independence is the cause without evidence. If unresolved, record one stable release-specific blocker with needs_founder false unless founder authority is demonstrably required. Collection remains a separate constraint; three unclassified feedback sources remain unknown. Stop after this attempt and retain all existing observation and retirement deadlines.

description: The approved supplier/Shopify comparer was rejected by the deployment gate repeatedly; publication remains unverified. Diagnose that specific release failure without further retries or bypassing independent review. Feedback remains uncertain: three unclassified sources establish neither zero demand nor customers. Payment collection blocks paid acceptance, not free delivery. Reconsider deployment only when documented evidence identifies an eligible route or the host condition changes.
